subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept this grouped set of 14 executable GitHub Action upgrades, including the Codex, token-minting, CodeQL, and Docker publishing actions, after secops verifies their pinned revisions?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but the affected workflows execute with secrets, tokens, publishing access, or security-scan permissions, and CODEOWNERS explicitly requires security-owner review.

options.title: Approve grouped upgrade
options.body: Secops accepts all reviewed pins together after the rebased exact-head checks and Codex contract inspection pass.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Land routine setup actions separately and isolate Codex, app-token, CodeQL, and Docker publishing upgrades for narrower approval.

options.title: Defer the update
options.body: Retain the current pins until the required security and dependency-contract reviews can be completed.

recommendation.title: Approve grouped upgrade
recommendation.body: Secops accepts all reviewed pins together after the rebased exact-head checks and Codex contract inspection pass.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest individual history in CI and action maintenance and is already subscribed, although required secops team approval still applies.
